description: Use this when designing retry behaviour for an SDK method that causes a side effect — picking the IsRetryable predicate, requiring an idempotency envelope (Idempotency-Key header, MessageID, upsert key) before any retry is legal, and capping attempts with jittered exponential backoff. Triggers: retry, backoff, jitter, idempotent, at-least-once, exactly-once, IsRetryable, MaxAttempts, MessageID, dedup.
